fixes.explanation: That's it, friend. Paul, the apostle, writes to Timothy, whom he calls his true child in the faith (1 Timothy 1:2). He says, “Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.” Double, not single. The most honor I ever got in the back of a junk drawer was a thin coat of dust.
